newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 6.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Feb. 6:

WASHINGTON - The budget that President Clinton will send to Congress will propose spending $3 billion a year to provide health coverage to children from low-income families as well as to parents who are temporarily unemployed.
WASHINGTON - Trying to crack its image as an elitist institution with well-to-do patrons, the Kennedy Center will begin offering a free performance every night at 6 p.m.

WASHINGTON - A D.C. police officer sitting in his patrol car at a red light was shot to death by a gunman who apparently was seeking revenge after being bounced from a nearby nightclub by another officer.
WASHINGTON - Downtown commuters are stunned as a gunman wounds a woman and then turns the weapon on himself amid morning rush hour.

WASHINGTON - Pamela Churchill Harriman, 76, a British-born aristocrat and intimate of some of the most prominent figures of the day who became a Democratic Party activist and Ambassador to France, died of a cerebral hemmorhage.
WASHINGTON - Americans in general may profess to be tired of the O.J. Simpson saga after two-and-a-half years and two exhaustively publicized trials, but empirical evidence suggests they are not.
